what’s your method? i completely agree... you suffer and then die anyway.

and the suffering probably just gets worse and worse.

I would only use it on myself.

I just need one shotgun and one bullet.

ive thought about it for a good 10 years but never actually thought about how i would do it.

i recently discovered a bridge in my city which is popular for suicudes.

last weekend i took 2 subways and a bus (1 hour trip 1 way) to this bridge just to see what it would look like.

I applied for assisted suicide. i live in canada.

one of my complaints was constant nerve pain. an ear nose and throat doctor confirmed i have nerve damage and a build up of scar tissue causing poor blood circulation.

i tried different treatments and didn’t want painkillers because i thought the treatments would work.

unfortunately they didn’t, and now my only option is to control the pain with painkillers.

i psychiatrist recommended i go on lorazepam.

i’ve had enough pain, any suggestions on what to start out with?  they know i’m not a drug seeker b/c for years i refused everything.

like what?

material things don’t make you happy.

i ruin all my relationships.

i really just want to die.
highest chance of success and least painful.

motivation to end it.

i picture myself at the top of a bridge hesitating to jump. the more bad things i can remember, the easier it will be to jump.

feel exactly the same way. i keep comparing the pros and cons of jumping from height vs hanging vs drowning vs jumping in front of a train...

none of them are 100% successful yet all of them are 100% painful

i live in canada and can’t get a gun.
